About the business

About Micheal Aderinto and Increase Original Super Store

Increase Original Super Store is a Lagos, Nigeria gadget retailer helping customers choose phones, tablets, laptops, smartwatches, audio products and everyday accessories with direct support before they buy.

Browse products and services Contact the branches

A clearer way to buy gadgets in Lagos

The business focuses on practical product guidance, current stock confirmation and straightforward communication through its Apapa and Badagry branches.

Popular device brands

Find iPhone, Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel options, along with foldables and other devices subject to current stock.

Useful accessories

Complete a setup with speakers, AirPods and earbuds, headphones, smartwatches, power banks, chargers and cables.

Direct buying support

Share the model, storage, condition or budget you want. The team can confirm current options on WhatsApp before you visit or arrange delivery.
